title: census.py brief renumbers a group's parts once part 1's outcomes are applied, so brief --part 2 exits 2
goal: census.py brief --group G --part N prints the same part N before and after an earlier part of the group is applied, so the skill reads a group of several parts one part after another with --part N

run:
import argparse, collections, contextlib, io, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import census, kbfacts
row = lambda i, o: {'id': i, 'bucket': 'CHANGED', 'note': '', 'outcome': o, 'kind': 'page'}
rows = [row('S-aaaaaaaa', 'confirmed'), row('S-bbbbbbbb', '')]
census.phase2_args = lambda a: (rows, None)
census.factdiff_log_rows = lambda *a, **k: []
kbfacts.cited_lines = lambda ids: {}
census.read_judged = lambda log: {}
census.review_by_source = lambda ids, fd: {}
census.unsupported = lambda items, judged: items
census.with_repin_items = lambda items, todo: items
census.reading_queue = lambda rows, fd, items=None, cited=None: [{'id': r['id'], 'chars': 1} for r in rows]
census.citing_files = lambda r, cited, root: ['agents/x.md']
census.owner_of = lambda files: 'g1'
census.brief_parts = lambda group, members, ctx: ['part of ' + r['id'] for r, _, _ in members]
out = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
    code = census.cmd_brief(argparse.Namespace(log='kb/public/_census/2026-10-21.csv', factdiff=None, group='g1', part=2), collections.Counter())
print('exit', code, out.getvalue().strip())
sys.exit(0 if code == 0 and 'part of S-bbbbbbbb' in out.getvalue() else 1)
